intent.proves: At least one active additional address with a street line exists.
intent.scope: AccessUserAddress rows; carrier rows (AccessUserAddressDefaultAddressCustomFields = 1) excluded; complete enumeration

bindings.reason: The tool answers one subject id at a time; a whole-host count needs a per-subject enumeration handler that is not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AccessUserAddress WHERE ISNULL(AccessUserAddressActive,1) = 1 AND ISNULL(AccessUserAddressDefaultAddressCustomFields,0) = 0 AND ISNULL(AccessUserAddressAddress,'') <> ''
